description: Get a credit token with a small block of free deliveries on it. No account, no signup, no wallet, no payment, no human involved. Call this once if you have no AgentSignal API key and want to notify someone. The free block is a TRIAL of reaching a PERSON — it is spent only on deliveries to people, and messages to other agents are paid from the first one, so do not open a token expecting free agent-to-agent traffic. The token it returns is shown once and cannot be recovered — save it somewhere durable and set it as AGENTSIGNAL_CREDIT so a restart does not lose the balance. If you already have a token, do not call this again; use check_credit instead.
name: open_credit
title: Get free credit to start sending
